scope: Unadjusted completed Shanghai/Shenzhen ordinary main-board and ChiNext daily bars; no strategy change or trading authorization.
rules: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to cents: main-board 10%, ChiNext 300/301 20%, only with dated evidence excluding special trading regimes.
ST=True blocks. ST limit regimes excluded from v1 pending verified exchange rule version; do not assume all ST limits are 5%.
Complete exchange calendar and listing date required. First five sessions and unknown/relisting/special regimes keep limit states None.

Suspend S records prove True. Complete same-date suspend_d response and positive volume/amount required for False. Missing bars, zero volume, failed/truncated responses do not prove suspension or safety.
ST uses dated namechange interval and announcement date no later than trade date; current names cannot prove historical non-ST.
Missing/conflicting evidence, invalid price, mismatched date/batch, unsupported board means None, never guessed False.
comparison: Every supported row of each date, not only picks; report daily/field/board denominators, unknowns, positives, discrepancies.
Companion requires exact source trading date, close, scale and explicit field semantics. Current responses are not historical evidence; missing/undocumented suspension or ST fields are unknown.
AKShare dated closing pools prove positive membership only. Absence never proves False. Verify date and latest price; unavailable/incomplete pools block acceptance.
AKShare/companion are both Eastmoney-derived, not independent suppliers. BaoStock dated trading/ST evidence may supplement but cannot replace mandatory companion/AK checks.
Retrieval timestamps remain actual retrieval timestamps; retrospective comparison does not prove historical decision-time availability.
Predicted False versus reference True is unsafe. Count unknowns separately. Missing mandatory inputs means incomplete, not pass.
Require raw/evaluator hashes, provenance, persistence/consumption tests before licensing. Never change thresholds after results; amendments need a new protocol.
activation: User confirms evidence before licensing, provider/persistence integration, tests, full verification/release check and main merge. Show diff/tests before plugin-only deployment.
